title: Tight constructions for reconfigurations of independent transversals
summary: For a graph $G$ and partition $\mathcal{U}$ of its vertex set, an independent transversal of $(G, \mathcal{U})$ is an independent set of $G$ that contains one vertex from each block of $\mathcal{U}$. Buys, Kang, and Ozeki studied when a reconfiguration graph on independent transversals of $(G,\mathcal{U})$ is connected, meaning any independent transversal can be transformed into any other one through a sequence of one-vertex modifications while always maintaining an independent transversal.
